references.text: The priest shall examine the wound and isolate the sick person for seven days—the same procedure of seven-day isolation to assess a skin disease.
The priest examines and isolates the person for seven days when the wound is suspicious—a parallel quarantine procedure.
The priest shall isolate the one with the wound for seven days and then re-examine it—the same pattern of seven-day observation.
The priest examines the wound and isolates the person for seven days—an identical procedure for evaluating impurity afflictions.
The person shall be isolated for seven days after the priest's examination—the same quarantine period.
The priest shall examine the plague in the house and shut it up for seven days—a parallel procedure for leprosy in a house.
Miriam was shut out from the camp for seven days because of leprosy—an example of seven-day isolation due to impurity.
